lessons.title: Do you exercise in winter?
lessons.description: One Minute English video lesson for Beginner learners.
lessons.transcriptHtml:
Hello, my name is Elizabeth. I am from America. And my question is, do you exercise in winter?

Yes, I exercise in winter. I like to walk my dog. I walk my dog to the park. I walk two hours a day. I do not belong to a gym. I like to exercise by myself. I lift weights at my house. I ride my bike. It is cold outside, but I like to exercise inside. I run outside. I run with my friend on the street. I run twice a week. I like to race, so I need to practice. Yes, I like to exercise in winter. It is not as hot as summer.

My question for you is, do you exercise in winter?

lessons.transcriptHtml:

I do not have a zoo in my town. My town is small. It has many animals. It has raccoons, it has squirrels, it has dogs and cats, it has ducks, but it does not have a zoo. I visit the zoo in a another town. It is a nice zoo. It is a small zoo. It does not have elephants, but it has giraffes. It has big birds, it has zebras. It does not have tigers, it does not have lions. But I love to visit the zoo. I can feed the farm animals there.

My question for you is, do you have a zoo in your town?

lessons.title: What is in your house?
lessons.description: One Minute English video lesson for Beginner learners.
lessons.transcriptHtml:
Hi, my name is Sarah and I will say 10 things about myself using articles "a" and "the" and I'll talk about what is in my house.

Okay. I have a washing machine. I also have a fridge. I have a small stove. I want a bigger stove. I don't have an electric toaster. I do have a vacuum cleaner, and I have a TV. I have an air conditioner, and I have a microwave. I want another TV.

So how about you? Can you say 10 things using articles about things in your house? You should try.

lessons.title: Is your house cold in winter?
lessons.description: One Minute English video lesson for Beginner learners.
lessons.transcriptHtml:
Hello, my name is Julie. I am from America. My question today, is your house cold in winter?

Yes. My house is very cold in winter, but my heater is warm and my jacket is warm, and my sweater is warm, and my hood is warm. But my house is not warm. My house is very cold outside. It is very cold in winter, but in summer it is not cold. In summer, it is very hot.

So my question for you is, is your house cold in winter?

lessons.title: Talk about a family member
lessons.description: One Minute English video lesson for Beginner learners.
lessons.transcriptHtml:
Hello, my name is Neri and I am from Belize. My question today is describe a family member.

The family member that I am going to describe is my little sister. My little sister is shorter than me. She is also fatter than me. My little sister lives far away from me. She does not live close to me. My little sister has a beautiful smile and she loves to dance. My little sister has blonde hair. My little sister is my best friend.

My question for you today is describe a family member.

lessons.description: One Minute English video lesson for Beginner learners.
lessons.transcriptHtml:
Hello, my name is Desiree. I am from a country called South Africa. My question today is, who are your friends?

My friends are Candace, Lisa and Mandy. Candace has long brown hair and is really short. Mandy has blonde hair and is very funny. She makes me laugh a lot, and Lisa lives all the way over in Wales. I only speak to her on messages and I really miss her.

My question for you is, who are your friends?

lessons.title: What is your nationality?
lessons.description: One Minute English video lesson for Beginner learners.
lessons.transcriptHtml:
Hello, my name is Dandara. I'm from Brazil, and my question is, what is your nationality?

Well, I am Brazilian. Brazil is a big country in South America, in Brazil. People speak Portuguese, but we also study English. Brazil is popular for its beaches, carnival and samba. People always ask me if I can dance samba. I usually say, "yes, a little." I am very proud to be Brazilian and I love sharing about Brazil with other people.

What about you? What is your nationality?

So, I live in South Africa, but I am from Cameroon. Cameroon is West Africa and next to Nigeria. I speak French, and Cameroon is near the ocean, so we eat a lot of fish and a lot of vegetables, and sometimes I miss Cameroon.

Hello, my name is Syuzan. I am from Armenia. My question is, what is your name?

My name is Syuzan. Syuzan, S-Y-U-Z-A-N. It is not a difficult name, right? It is a beautiful name. For me, it means flower. I am a flower. Syuzan is a common name. Sometimes people call me Susie for short. I like it too. My name is very special to me.

Tell me, what is your name?

lessons.title: Ten Things about Me!
lessons.description: One Minute English video lesson for Beginner learners.
lessons.transcriptHtml:

My name is Sarah.
I am a mother.
I am also a teacher.
I am not a farmer.
I am not shy.
My daughter is seven years old. She is brave.
My son is five years old. He is kind.
My children are friendly. They are happy, too.
My family is from the USA. We are American.

How about you?

Can you say 10 things using simple present with Be?

You should try.
